settings.title: Privacy Policy
settings.subheading: How we handle your personal information, order data, and store privacy when you shop on Purelane.

settings.title: Personal Data Protection
settings.text: Your contact and delivery details are used solely to process orders, deliver shipments, and provide support.

settings.title: Secure Checkout
settings.text: All transactions are securely encrypted and processed through authorized payment gateway partners.

settings.heading: 1. Information We Collect
settings.body: When you purchase or browse Purelane, we collect necessary order details (Name, Shipping Address, Email Address, Phone Number) strictly to fulfill deliveries, provide order updates, and offer customer support.

settings.heading: 2. Cookies & Analytics
settings.body: We use basic functional cookies to maintain your shopping bag across sessions and analyze aggregated site performance to improve store navigation and speed.

settings.heading: 3. Your Rights & Data Requests
settings.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by emailing our customer support team at support@purelane.com.

settings.default_body: Purelane is committed to respecting your privacy and protecting the security of your personal data.
